name: GitHub
description: Connect your GitHub account to inspect repositories, read project files, and create issues. Every write action is separately approval-gated.

name: Google Workspace
actions: Gmail: search, read, draft and send email
Calendar: read events, check availability and manage schedules
Drive: find, read, upload and organize files
Docs and Sheets: create, read and edit documents and spreadsheets
Contacts, Tasks and Meet: access supported workspace tools
description: Connect one Google account through Google's OAuth consent screen. Google Super unifies Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Contacts, Tasks, Meet and other supported Google services in one connection. ULTRON never asks for your Google password; write actions remain approval-gated.
